You have the latest version of Solegram
Solegram is a free Telegram client based on the official Telegram for Android source code. It is not affiliated with Telegram.
Built on Telegram for Android (GPL-2.0). Plugin API compatible with the exteraGram plugin SDK. Hooking by LSPlant/AliuHook, Python by Chaquopy.
No haptic feedback or vibration inside the app
Glass floats above your chats like a separate layer, so content stays readable while the interface stays light. Turn it off to save battery on older phones.
This text is shown on top of the chat list instead of "Solegram".

Thickness sets the width of the curved edge; strength and index set how much the glass bends what is under it. Dispersion splits the edge into colours like a real lens.

For videos from the camera and round videos. Maximum goes up to 60 frames per second and lets the camera slow down in the dark so the picture stays bright. 60 fps holds a steady 60 where the camera can, which can look darker in low light. On slower phones 30 can be smoother.
Menus and buttons flow out of what opens them, like drops of liquid
Emoji in a round button on the left, attachments inside the text field, voice and send on the right

The camera in Telegram shoots at full resolution and best quality and focuses right before the shot. With this on, Solegram also processes every photo: brighter shadows and softer highlights as in HDR, less noise in the dark, crisper details and natural colours. It takes about a second after the shot.
Photos taken with the camera are sent at 2560 pixels instead of 1280, so details stay sharp. The HD button in the editor still switches it for a single photo.
Checks public proxies and turns on the fastest
Proxy on: %1$s, %2$d ms. Working proxies found: %3$d
The lists could not be downloaded, the saved list was used.
Could not download the proxy lists, and there is no saved list yet. Check the internet connection and try again.
None of %1$d proxies responded. Try again later: the lists are updated often.
Find a proxy when Telegram cannot connect

If Telegram cannot connect for about 20 seconds, Solegram finds a working proxy and turns it on by itself, and every few hours checks the proxies it found. A proxy you added yourself is never replaced.
Delete the proxies Solegram found (%1$d)? Proxies you added yourself stay.

Solegram takes public MTProto proxies from open lists and keeps the fastest. Messages stay encrypted all the way to Telegram servers: an MTProto proxy cannot read them. The owner of a proxy sees your IP address and that you use Telegram. Speed differs from proxy to proxy.
The transcribe button on voice messages and round videos for everyone
Auto: on the device, and your AI service if that does not work
On the device: free, the audio stays on the phone
AI: your own OpenAI-compatible service with Whisper
For example whisper-1 (OpenAI) or whisper-large-v3-turbo (Groq). Leave empty for the default.

First the phone recognizes the speech itself: free, and Solegram sends the audio nowhere. Language packs come from the speech recognition service of the phone (Android 13 or newer). If that does not work and your own AI service is chosen above, the audio is sent there. With Premium, Telegram transcription stays in this mode.

Free and private: the speech is recognized by the speech service of the phone, Solegram sends the audio nowhere (on some phones that service itself uses the internet). Needs Android 13 or newer; language packs are downloaded in the speech recognition settings of the phone.

The audio of a message is sent to your AI service (OpenAI, Groq or another one with Whisper) when you tap the transcribe button. The free AI service cannot transcribe speech. Audio from secret chats and chats that forbid forwarding is never sent.
Recognition on the device needs Android 13 or newer. Choose AI in Solegram settings.
This phone has no speech recognition service. Install Speech Recognition and Synthesis from Google or choose AI in Solegram settings.
Recognition of %1$s is not downloaded to this phone. Download the language pack? You can also choose AI in Solegram settings.
The language pack is downloading. Try again when it is ready.

Where Gemini Nano is available, the summary is made right on the phone and the text never leaves it. Otherwise, or when Nano is busy, the text goes to the free Pollinations.ai service, only when you ask for a summary; the first time the app asks for permission. Secret chats and chats that forbid forwarding are never summarized.

The summary is made by Gemini Nano right on the phone: the text never leaves it, even without internet. Android lets it work only while Solegram is open and limits how much it can be used per day; very long texts are summarized in parts. Secret chats and chats that forbid forwarding are never summarized.

Gemini Nano is not available on this phone

Gemini Nano works on recent phones with Android AICore: Pixel 9 and newer, Galaxy S25 and newer, recent Xiaomi, OnePlus, OPPO, vivo, Honor and some others. It does not work with an unlocked bootloader. Right after a reset or an update Android may still be getting its AI setup: try again later. Until then the free service makes the summaries in Auto mode.
